notes: Real captures produced by the Megi engine. WebP files are lossless (pixel-identical to the source PNG); PNG files are lossless re-encodings (pixel-identical, alpha channel dropped because the captures are fully opaque), except phase4-basic.png which is a byte-for-byte copy of the documented capture because re-encoding grew the file. No content was altered: no crops, no retouching, native aspect ratio preserved. WebP quality is lossless (better than the required quality >= 82).
